comment: stderr the pinned rclone 1.75.1 printed (with -q), recorded on macOS against unreachable endpoints, the T2 SFTP server with a mismatched host key, a missing key and a read-only folder, and (Task 17) SeaweedFS refusing If-None-Match and the system ssh closing under rclone's ssh option; paths shortened. `expect` is how the adapter classifies the exit: a refused host key is a failure to fix, never an unreachable store.
